related_questions.question: How do I owe money on state taxes?
related_questions.snippet: If you paid too little in withholding then you may owe additional tax. If you live in a state that assesses income tax, then you'll need to file a state return along with your federal return. This return determines what you owe in state income taxes, based on your income and which tax deductions or credits you claim.
